title: Wasabi Warrior
description: Five karate students living together in a world where they must outplay, outfight, and outwit one another. They’ll be playing for a brand-new Kamasaki water rider.
quote: You’re about to enter a world of mental and physical challenges where you should always expect the unexpected.
altHero: Sensei Rudy and five karate kids up on a high ledge
alt2: two karate kids on platforms across from each other, connected by a bridge of a pool of mud
alt3: karate kid clinging to a beam as heavy bags swing around him
alt4: chef lifts cloche to reveal a bowl of worms, and a karate girl is terrified
